Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft for HealthPlus (post-discovery)

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the discovery call today, great context on your performance goals and constraints. Per our conversation, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to help align milestones, owners, and timeline toward a pilot and purchase decision. I summarized the key points below and included two timeline options so you can pick what fits your internal cadence.

Quick recap from today
- Primary goal: reduce per-inference cost by 40% while meeting 99th percentile latency targets for the patient-facing triage flow.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, SSO integration, and production data residency in us-east-1.
- Typical success criteria: stable baseline latency <150ms p99, cost per 1k tokens target, and validated privacy controls.

Initial MAP highlights (attached: HealthPlus_REDWOOD_MAP_draft_v1.docx)
- Milestone 1: Technical kickoff & environment setup
  - Owner: HealthPlus (Derek Owens)
  - Redwood support: aditya_rao (solutions) + rachel_kim (infra)
  - Target: 2 weeks after kickoff
- Milestone 2: PoC (integration + smoke tests)
  - Owner: Redwood (adoption runbook + sample app)
  - Target: 4 weeks from environment ready
- Milestone 3: Pilot validation (latency/cost/QA)
  - Owner: HealthPlus product + Redwood SRE
  - Target: 6 weeks from PoC start
- Milestone 4: Contract & procurement
  - Owner: HealthPlus procurement (Karen Li)
  - Target: concurrent with pilot validation

Dependencies and risks
- SOC 2 attestation / security questionnaire (HealthPlus needs vendor evidence)
- SSO + SAML configuration window
- Demo environment access and sample PII masking guide

Two timeline options (pick A or B)
- Option A (accelerated): target close date 2026-06-30 — aggressive, assumes SOC2 attestation and procurement window fit within pilot timeline.
- Option B (conservative): target close date 2026-07-15 — allows extra time for procurement and compliance review.

Asks / next steps
1) Please confirm the primary stakeholders we should include on the MAP (owners for each milestone).
2) Which timeline option (A or B) do you prefer?
3) Can we schedule a 60-min MAP workshop to finalize owners and agree on deliverables? I can propose slots next week.

Attachments: HealthPlus_REDWOOD_MAP_draft_v1.docx, pricing_sheet_Q1.pdf
Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMAPdraft

Thanks, happy to update the doc live during the workshop.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
